cloudflare.label: Trust Cloudflare for visitor addresses
cloudflare.helper: Reads the visitor address from CF-Connecting-IP, but only for connections from Cloudflare's published ranges; a forged header from anywhere else is ignored. Any Cloudflare customer can reach your server through their own proxied record, so this does not prove a request came through your zone.
cloudflare.neverRefreshed: Not refreshed yet, using the shipped list.
cloudflare.failed: Could not change the Cloudflare client IP setting

fallbackCerts.label: Certificates for automatic addresses
fallbackCerts.helper: Eager orders the certificate as soon as the route exists; lazy orders it at the first visit to the automatic address. Domains you add yourself are always eager.
fallbackCerts.envHint: Seeded from {{env}}. Saving a value here overrides it.
